problem: Parallel recovery and audit-only hygiene amplified GitHub Actions queue pressure, repository drift and avoidable CI cost.
root_cause: Recovery could dispatch multiple terminal closures concurrently across obligations, while scheduled hygiene classified debt without applying already fail-closed cleanup.
prevention: Serialize terminal closure recovery globally and dispatch at most one missing terminal closure per supervisor cycle.
Keep per-PR terminal closure concurrency non-cancelling so an active canonical proof is never replaced by a newer duplicate.
Preserve fail-closed semantics for real production-readback failures; only missing or cancelled readbacks may use descendant live proof.
Run scheduled repository hygiene in apply mode using explicit resource budgets and existing unique-commit protections.
Bound candidate closures, branch evaluations and deletions per run to reduce API, runner and queue amplification.
